//buildCommand: THIS IS `vite build`, NOT `npm run build`, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE PRERENDER.
Pinned here because the dashboard's copy was the one Vercel actually used and nothing in the
repo said so. It was set when this was a plain Base44 export, and it has meant that every
production deploy ships the SPA shell alone: none of the 16 prerendered pages, and none of
the five checks chained after the prerender. Measured live 2026-09-03, /home/index.html,
/blog/index.html and /404.html each answered with the 2062-byte root shell, because those
files were not in the deployment at all.
WHY THE FULL BUILD CANNOT RUN HERE YET. scripts/prerender.mjs drives a real Chrome over CDP
and resolves it as CHROME_PATH || 'C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe'.
Vercel builds on Linux and no browser ships in the image, and there is no puppeteer in
devDependencies to supply one. The missing-browser throw is caught, so the crawl does not
fail — it marks all 16 routes skipped and writes shells — and the build then dies at
check-category-text.mjs, which requires the 100 category names to be real text in
dist/home/index.html. Correct behaviour from both: neither will certify a shell as a snapshot.
So the pipeline is real, tested and green on a Windows workstation, and has never once been
runnable in CI. Pointing this key at `npm run build` fails the deploy outright, which is worse
than shipping shells, so it stays on `vite build` until the crawl has a browser on Linux.
TO FINISH IT: add puppeteer as a devDependency and set CHROME_PATH from
puppeteer.executablePath(), or run the crawl outside CI and deploy with --prebuilt. Until then
the rewrites below resolve only because Vercel falls through to index.html for a missing
target, which is why the site works for people and is invisible to anything that does not run JS.
ignoreCommand: git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- src public index.html vercel.json vite.config.js tailwind.config.js postcss.config.js jsconfig.json package.json package-lock.json

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https://cash4itnow-platform.vercel.app; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
